class.name: NNDistanceVector3Sensor
class.brief_description: Measures the 3D distance between two positions and scales it to [code]0..1[/code].
class.description: Computes the distance between [member from_vector] and [member to_vector] and scales it relative to [member max_distance] using squared distance for fast evaluation. Useful for scoring proximity in 3D without recalculating distances in each consideration. Can also compute the exact [member distance] and normalized [member direction_vector] on demand.

members.member: Normalized [member from_to_vector]. Only updated when [member is_direction_vector_calculated] is [code]true[/code].
Exact distance between [member from_vector] and [member to_vector]. Only updated when [member is_distance_calculated] or [member is_direction_vector_calculated] is [code]true[/code].
Squared distance between [member from_vector] and [member to_vector].
Start position for the distance calculation.
If [code]true[/code], also computes [member direction_vector] and [member distance] on evaluation.
If [code]true[/code], also computes the exact [member distance] on evaluation.
Distance that maps to a sensor value of [code]1.0[/code] (using squared distance, unclamped). Must be non-zero.
End position for the distance calculation.
